I-353 (amanatar V6 3-frame look-ahead, deferred-after-deadline) and I-442 (DIVERGE 2.25 -> 1.50, refuted) are the direct matches. I-333 (2.5/2.75 deferred, 3.0 a cliff) covers the other side of the value. The scan's 'forkmid' mapping is not the match. A DIVERGE of 0.4 nearly switches the gate off, which is the 'more safe divisions' direction that read flat on probes 43/44. Their run carries no LB information: the log shows postlink divisions 0->0, accepted 0 and removed_edges 0 on all 4 public videos, on the royerlab predictor, and HANDOFF says 'submission still queued' with no score. (3) The other 3 repos (full trees checked) are other families. MapleBadger666 is its own UNet/transformer 'Frozen V9' with no LB score. Jin-Ruoting is Aman Atar geometric fusion, 0.947. Tobi-joshua is a Hungarian tracker. Their values map to DIS < 2 (closed), DET_THRESHOLD (I-309) and MIN_TRACK_LEN (I-129). (4) FEASIBILITY: 3 of 5 29-Sep slots are used. The 2 left belong to MORNING TABLE v1.1, and R34-RC-A's exp89u already competes for an UNUSED one. A new build needs a ~3 h GPU dummy plus a 7-10 h read, so it lands after the 20:00Z tick, and R8 bars new mechanisms. E[gain] is 0.
